data.name: Step1_Headline
data.value: From your request to an editable flow

data.name: Step1_Description
data.value:
Describe your goal in plain language. The **AI Assistant** uses an external cloud AI, such as OpenAI, Anthropic, or DeepSeek, to answer questions and implement complete requirements.
Through the **FlowBlox Tool API**, it creates and configures flow blocks, retrieves information, and tests or debugs flows. You can review and continue editing the resulting project. Requests and relevant project or tool data are sent to the selected provider.

data.name: Step2_Headline
data.value: Skills extend what the assistant can do

data.name: Step2_Description
data.value:
**Skills** give the assistant focused capabilities, such as retrieving web content, reading local files, or querying databases, using your available connections and permissions. The assistant reuses bundled Skills. If a required Skill is missing, it can create a compact **Skill Project** with defined inputs and outputs to provide it.
Before execution, FlowBlox requests your **approval**, unless you have already allowed that project permanently. Review the reason, project, and **input parameters**. Choose **Allow once** or **Always allow**; permanent approvals can be revoked under Options → AI → ApprovedSkillProjects.

data.name: Step3_Headline
data.value: Configure a provider and API key

data.name: Step3_Description
data.value:
**1. Create an account** with an AI cloud provider and generate an **API key**. API access usually requires credit or activated usage-based billing; a chat subscription generally does not include API usage.
**2. Open Configuration** using the gear icon in the AI Assistant. Add a **provider**, select its **model**, enter the **API key**, and save.
**3. Describe your task** and send it. Usage is billed by the selected provider.

data.name: Step4_Headline
data.value: Choose a model to suit your priorities

data.name: Step4_Description
data.value:
**Highest quality:** We recommend **OpenAI** or **Anthropic / Claude** for demanding requirements and complex flows. Choose a capable current model from the provider.
**Best price-performance:** We recommend **DeepSeek Flash** (`deepseek-flash`) for cost-conscious everyday use.
These are starting recommendations. Quality, speed, and costs depend on the selected model and task. Check the provider’s current API pricing before use.

data.name: Option_Completed_Description
data.value: Tracks whether the AI Assistant quick-start guidance has been completed.
